$Comment: Quarter Saw's second find roll (a Crafting talent, a face of the Mill Technique): named by Extensions/SawmillProgression.json on the Mill's one action and rolled on every cycle, each roll gated on the talent's own record (ziggfreedcommon:track_pick, Min 1), so it rolls only for the talent's holder, whose cycle the same extension's Pace makes half again as long. Each roll grants a Lootable reward naming one find band (SawmillLuckFinds, SawmillDeepFinds) beside its Treasure Cut twin (Mmo_Sawmill_Treasure_Luck, Mmo_Sawmill_Treasure_Deep) with Trigger Cycle, so the band rolls again against this same cycle: the same score, the Woodcutting 30 gate on the deep band, and every Mill Trade gate inside the bands, so a player gets the band that is theirs. Mill Practice (a Crafting talent) makes the second roll likelier the way the tree's find talents do: a tenth of its holder's cycles a rank, both bands roll a third time. Pair it with the Pace ladder when retuning.

Rolls.$Comment: Mill Practice: ten percent of cycles a rank (twenty at both ranks), both bands roll a third time.
